يحتجمون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِمُونَ (yaḥtajimūna) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# يُحْتَجَمُونَ (yuḥtajamūna) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
